steps.objective: 完成「案例介面與可識別量」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Case interfaces and identifiable quantities and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付逐原子搬移圖、分段損失與目標佔據驗收。
在交接件中加入「案例介面與可識別量」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：介面表應明示輸出單位survival probability、全部輸入與下列模型限制：獨立搬移的生存代理P=s^m，s為單次存活、m為搬移次數；不假設移動越短就必然無損。 圖中不得把量測值與廠商規格混同。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立『QuEra 原子重排：每次搬移損失的累積』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付逐原子搬移圖、分段損失與目標佔據驗收。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver atom-by-atom move maps, segment losses and target-occupancy acceptance.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Case interfaces and identifiable quantities: The interface table must state output unit survival probability, all inputs and these model limits: Independent-transport survival proxy P=s^m uses per-move survival s and move count m; shorter motion is not assumed lossless. Do not confuse measurements with vendor specifications.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'QuEra atom rearrangement: accumulated transport loss', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver atom-by-atom move maps, segment losses and target-occupancy acceptance. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。介面表應明示輸出單位survival probability、全部輸入與下列模型限制：獨立搬移的生存代理P=s^m，s為單次存活、m為搬移次數；不假設移動越短就必然無損。 圖中不得把量測值與廠商規格混同。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. The interface table must state output unit survival probability, all inputs and these model limits: Independent-transport survival proxy P=s^m uses per-move survival s and move count m; shorter motion is not assumed lossless. Do not confuse measurements with vendor specifications.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 介面表應明示輸出單位survival probability、全部輸入與下列模型限制：獨立搬移的生存代理P=s^m，s為單次存活、m為搬移次數；不假設移動越短就必然無損。 圖中不得把量測值與廠商規格混同。
steps.checkEn: The interface table must state output unit survival probability, all inputs and these model limits: Independent-transport survival proxy P=s^m uses per-move survival s and move count m; shorter motion is not assumed lossless. Do not confuse measurements with vendor specifications.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 光鑷平台用光學控制維持原子陣列。
knowledge.textEn: Optical-tweezer platforms use optical control to maintain atomic arrays.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立『QuEra 原子重排：每次搬移損失的累積』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付逐原子搬移圖、分段損失與目標佔據驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'QuEra atom rearrangement: accumulated transport loss', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver atom-by-atom move maps, segment losses and target-occupancy acceptance.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 獨立搬移的生存代理P=s^m，s為單次存活、m為搬移次數；不假設移動越短就必然無損。
knowledge.textEn: Independent-transport survival proxy P=s^m uses per-move survival s and move count m; shorter motion is not assumed lossless.

stages.title: 案例介面與可識別量
stages.description: 依『QuEra 原子重排：每次搬移損失的累積』畫出最小系統邊界，將下列量分成控制、狀態與量測三欄：教學s=0.995、關鍵原子需m=10次搬移。 對照案例來源，只保留其實際支持的架構敘述；把所有合成數值標記『教學』。
stages.descriptionEn: Draw the smallest system boundary for 'QuEra atom rearrangement: accumulated transport loss'. Classify these quantities as controls, states or measurements: Teaching s=0.995 and m=10 moves for a critical atom. Keep only architectural claims supported by the case source and label every synthetic value 'teaching'.
